dimensions.note: No credentials, secrets, or external services are used.
The record method logs structured, non-sensitive entry and completion events for create, replay, and repair outcomes.
Validation, replay conflict, chronology, and reconsideration failures occur before their corresponding writes and return actionable errors.
Synthetic tests cover strict schemas, authority rejection, replay conflict, interrupted-write repair, chronology, reconsideration, and structured logging.
Exact replay is a no-op when complete and repairs only the missing latest-decision projection after an interrupted second write.
The model makes no external API calls.
The model opens no external connections, streams, files, or process handles.
README examples and tests use generic synthetic identifiers and hashes without host or infrastructure details.
The public argument, record, dossier, actor, authority, and evidence objects are strict.
Both immutable decision and latest-decision resources explicitly declare infinite lifetime and bounded retained versions.
This is an immutable decision ledger rather than an external CRUD lifecycle model.
The only effect is validated local record persistence; there is no external mutating operation requiring live or policy preflight.
Decision and proposal-latest names are deterministic, distinct, and always written against schemas with the same validated record shape.
Existing decisions and proposal history are read exclusively through readResource.
This is the initial standalone package version and does not migrate an earlier published package version.
